svg.title: MedWorld-JEPA structured current-state learning
svg.desc: Current medical imaging enters a 2D or 3D JEPA and a shared visual spine, producing dense, global, anatomy, pathology, lesion and trajectory state groups. Report, regions and patient time add short supervision routes. Task queries selectively read the state. A separate stop-gradient EMA branch observes the future only to align target and predicted clinical transitions.

g.text: A REUSABLE STATE · QUERIES READ; THEY DO NOT WRITE
DOTS MARK THE STATE GROUPS EACH QUERY CAN READ
